_note: Production map template for cms-migration/generate_hosted_bundle.js. Copy this file to cms-migration/asset-map.json, then replace every <generated-suffix> with the REAL suffix Assettype assigned when the file was uploaded. The generator refuses to run while any placeholder or missing entry remains — it never fabricates URLs.
valueShape: Each suffixes value is the part of the hosted URL after /prajavani/ (example: 2026/08/10/a1b2c3d4-tomato-thumb-real.png — the actual date/hash segment Assettype returns for that upload). A full https:// URL is also accepted.
note: The generator requires a real entry for every requiredKeys entry PLUS every ./assets/ path it discovers referenced by the root app.js/styles.css (that full set is computed at runtime — currently ~166 asset paths). Add every referenced path to suffixes with its real Assettype suffix; do NOT fabricate values. assets/OG Image.png is not referenced by app.js/styles.css, but it is still required by cms-migration/index.html (og:image), so keep its entry populated.
warning: The dashboard is NOT production-ready until every placeholder in this map, hosted-config.example.json, and index.html is replaced with a real Assettype-generated URL. No placeholder is a valid runtime URL.
